Getting started

Three ways to start.

Clearly scoped starter offers with a fixed frame. Larger projects are planned together afterwards.

Technical Documentation

Document check with 614 One

Pre-review of a manual or technical document against basic requirements, DIN EN IEC/IEEE 82079-1 and CE rules, with an expert read-through.

  • Client report with score, traffic light and to-do list
  • Report in English, German, Ukrainian or Russian
  • Exact locations instead of a blanket verdict

Fixed price per document
from €190 · 3 working days

Request a check

Software & Web Applications

Prototype in a few weeks

A spreadsheet, a workflow or an idea becomes a working prototype that shows whether further development pays off.

  • Requirements clarified in one workshop
  • A working prototype instead of slides
  • Handover with code, instructions and tests

Fixed price by scope
from €2,400 · 2–4 weeks

Discuss a prototype

Automation assessment

How I work

  3. 03

  4. 04

    Evaluate the result against agreed criteria and hand it over.

NAHX

The A stands for the standard.

Understanding technology means knowing it from the inside: structure, material, load. The A in the name is a closed, load-bearing body, nothing decorative. The results should be the same: robust, verifiable, clear.
